purpose: Separate full-M versus sampled-row W2 numerical behavior using original saved q2 rows. Two shapes, same ordered rows/weights/bias and original matmul default settings; no QDQ or new candidate.
controls: Unknown token rows are zero; measured160 rows occupy their original full-M coordinates. Dense Linear is mathematically independent across rows; compare actual BF16 results at those rows. No original full-state or whole-FFN equivalence is inferred.

hypotheses.H_shape: If GEMM M/row placement controls the discrepancy, restoring original M and row positions should reduce it or recover byte equality.
hypotheses.H_other: If reduced scope still differs, source/config/runtime, captures or precision/layout remain competing explanations.

source_snapshot_policy: Reuse and verify all37 immutable previous C02 source snapshots; copy only new tool/test and this protocol. All original eight operands and four weight shards are rehashed.
